# dump

Bundle PPDS logs and diagnostics into a zip file for bug reports

## Usage

```
ppds logs dump [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | `string` |  | Directory to write the zip into (default: current directory) |
